column1: # The game's music, built by tools/import-music.sh from Voltz Supreme's "Analog Ambience" zips in music/.
# One row per file the game plays. Columns are separated by tabs; write - for an empty optional column.
#   mood      voyage (map, fitting, grove, dock, shipyard, event, reward), fight, boss, or stings
#   name      the file name in game/audio/music/<mood>/ without .ogg; the stings must be named won and lost
#   source    the WAV's file name inside the zips (the names are unique across the three zips)
#   start     optional: where to start, in seconds
#   end       optional: where to stop, in seconds
#   fade_out  optional: seconds of fade-out before the end; needs end
# Left out of the game: Creepy (too dark), Simple Synth and Black Energy (too calm for the boss), Head in a Fishtank -
# Just Bubbles (a thinned-out copy of Head in a Fishtank), Dreamy Ending (Long).

column3: Voltz Supreme - March of The Blips.wav
